sources.title: Malian diplomatic missions: visa assistant
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, Mali
sources.officialityEvidence: The live diplomatiemdc.gouv.ml Ministry portal offers a nationality, passport-type, residence and filing-location assistant. Its results are not an exhaustive current legal schedule and do not identify issuance timing.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Ai-je besoin d’un visa pour voyager au Mali ?

sources.title: Practical information for Mali
sources.publisher: Federal Public Service Foreign Affairs, Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation, Belgium
sources.officialityEvidence: Belgium's current Mali advisory was last updated 22 May 2026. It delegates necessary travel-document information to the Malian Embassy rather than stating Belgian ordinary-passport visa liability or issuance timing.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Alle noodzakelijke reisdocumenten worden vermeld ... op de website van de Ambassade van Mali.

sources.title: Le Visa
sources.publisher: Embassy of Mali in Belgium and Europe
sources.officialityEvidence: The Malian Embassy's live page, updated 20 March 2025, directs prospective applicants to the Ministry's competent-mission assistant and separately lists passport drop-off and collection hours. It never ties that generic workflow to Belgian ordinary-passport visitor liability.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Dépôt des passeports ... Retrait des passeports

sources.title: Mali Travel Advice & Safety
sources.publisher: Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade, Australian Government
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Smartraveller Mali advice was updated 11 June 2026 and marked current 24 August 2026. It states liability but directs travellers only to contact an embassy, without an actual issuance route or timing.
sources.supportingExcerpt: you'll need to get a visa. ... Contact the nearest Embassy of Mali for details

sources.title: Mali travel advice
sources.officialityEvidence: The current NetherlandsWorldwide Mali advisory directly identifies a Dutch passport's visa liability, but merely refers the traveller to the Malian Embassy and supplies no issuance point or timing.
sources.supportingExcerpt: U heeft een visum nodig voor Mali als u met een Nederlands paspoort reist.

unresolved.reason: No current Singapore passport-authority or Malian primary source joins an ordinary Singapore passport's visitor liability to an identified pre-travel issuing route. The Malian assistant's generic required result is not normalized.
